svg.text: Read the story: The Lost Puppy
On a rainy evening, Meera heard a soft sound outside
her door. She opened it and found a small brown puppy.
It was wet and shivering. Meera dried it with a towel
and gave it some warm milk. The next morning, she saw
a notice on the lamp post: ‘Lost: brown puppy named
Coco. Please call Mr. Shah.’ Meera called Mr. Shah,
and he came to take Coco home. He was so happy that
he gave Meera a big box of chocolates.
